files.siminp/input.lmp:
# created by fftool, adapted for MFDA restarts (see md_pipeline.py)
# Identical to algo_chemical_model/data/input.lmp except for the 'restart' command
# and 'run ... upto' (a resumed run stops at the same absolute timestep).

# System settings
units real
boundary p p p  # Periodic boundary conditions

# definition of atoms, bonds, angles
atom_style full
bond_style harmonic
angle_style harmonic

# definition of pair potentials
special_bonds lj/coul 0.0 0.0 0.5
pair_style lj/cut/coul/long 10.0 10.0
pair_modify mix geometric tail yes
kspace_style pppm 1.0e-5

# read data file
read_data ../siminp/data.lmp

# definition of LJ parameters
pair_coeff    1    1     0.000000     0.000000  # Hw Hw
pair_coeff    2    2     0.163400     3.174270  # Ow-Ow

# definition of partial charges
set type 1 charge  0.44760000  # Hw
set type 2 charge -0.89520000  # Ow

############################################

# remove energy hotspots
# generous caps (10000 iterations / 100000 force evaluations): with 100 the
# minimiser can stop before converging (N=16 needed 119); extra cost is seconds
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 10000 100000
reset_timestep 0

# constrain water bonds and angles
fix fSHAKE all shake 0.0001 20 0 b 1 a 1

# remove Center of Mass movement every 100 steps
fix fMOM all momentum 100 linear 1 1 1

# define the neighbor list
neighbor 2.0 bin

# IMPORTANT: timestep and temperature and pressure
timestep 1.0
variable vTK equal 298.15
variable vPBAR equal 1.0

# randomize velocities
velocity all create ${vTK} 1328400118

# thermostat (solving the ODE)
fix fTHERMO all nvt temp ${vTK} ${vTK} 100

# print settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step etotal ke pe temp press vol density
# trajectory output
dump dEQUI all custom 1000 equi.lammpstrj id element xu yu zu
dump_modify dEQUI element H O sort id

# restart files every 100 ps; '*' is replaced by the timestep, so no file is ever
# overwritten (placed after minimize/reset_timestep: no file from the minimiser)
restart 100000 restart.*

# equilibration
# 250 ps (timestep counter was reset to 0 above)
run 250000 upto
# write data file
write_data data.after_eq.lmp

# clean up
undump dEQUI

# production
# 1 ns (until absolute timestep 1 250 000)
dump dPROD all custom 1000 prod.lammpstrj id element xu yu zu
dump_modify dPROD element H O sort id
run 1250000 upto

# write data file
write_data data.after_prod.lmp

# clean up
undump dPROD
unfix fTHERMO
unfix fMOM
unfix fSHAKE
